definition: SQLAlchemy is the standard Python toolkit and ORM for talking to SQL databases.
details: Created by Michael Bayer in 2006 and maintained by the SQLAlchemy open-source project.

explainer.lead: How to install SQLAlchemy, a first working example, and where it fits in an AI project.

quickstart.python:
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text

engine = create_engine("sqlite:///app.db")
with engine.connect() as conn:
    rows = conn.execute(text("SELECT id, prompt FROM chats LIMIT 5"))
    for row in rows:
        print(row.id, row.prompt)

explainer.inAi: Store prompts, responses and feedback for an LLM app, or give a text-to-SQL agent a database to query.
explainer.jsNote: Python only. In JavaScript, Prisma, Drizzle or Knex play the same role.
